title: The Peace Embassy
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold palace hour; refined linework
style_master_ref: mood: cream-saffron-gold comic (do not attach Ep01 Drona figure plate)
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

plates.beat_text: The years of exile end. Armies gather — and one last chance for peace remains.
must_show: Premium painted comic: camps and banners on plains, sense of coming war
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide plain at golden hour: Pandava camp tents and banners, armies gathering in soft distance. Krishna and Yudhishthira small or mid figures discussing. Sense of last chance before war. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Krishna takes the Pandavas’ plea to Hastinapura: five villages, and no war.
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Yudhishthira requests Krishna to go as peace envoy; Krishna in yellow pitambar accepts with calm smile. Camp tent interior. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He rides toward the city of the Kurus as messenger, friend, and witness of dharma.
must_show: Krishna on chariot toward distant city of Hastinapura
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna in yellow pitambar rides a chariot on a royal road toward a distant golden palace city of Hastinapura. Peaceful but purposeful. Cream-saffron sky. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: In the great sabha Dhritarashtra sits blind; Duryodhana’s pride fills the hall.
must_show: Premium quality regal Kuru sabha hall
Blind king Dhritarashtra on throne; Duryodhana proud among seated princes
Equal natural human scale, men of the court only
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra regal sabha. Blind elderly king Dhritarashtra on throne. Proud Duryodhana in jewel tones among seated princes. Grand pillars, equal natural human scale. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Krishna offers peace: five villages for the sons of Pandu. Nothing more is asked.
must_show: Krishna speaking peace in sabha with open hand gesture
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna stands in the Kuru sabha offering peace with open hand. Dhritarashtra on throne; Duryodhana scowls. Golden court light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Duryodhana refuses. He will not give land enough to drive a needle’s point.
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Duryodhana stands defiant refusing Krishna’s offer; Krishna remains serene. Court tension. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: When they plot to seize him, Krishna shows a fraction of his cosmic form — and the hall trembles.
must_show: Tasteful Vishvarupa-lite: Krishna radiant multi-armed or cosmic glow filling sabha — charming comic not horror CGI
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna reveals a tasteful cosmic form in the sabha — radiant many-armed divine presence with soft gold light filling the hall. Courtiers and Duryodhana shield their eyes in awe. Sacred charming mythic style, NOT horror CGI. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He returns to the Pandavas. Peace has failed. The road to Kurukshetra is open.
must_show: Krishna returns to Pandava camp; solemn faces
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna returns to the Pandava camp at dusk; Yudhishthira and brothers receive the failed peace with solemn resolve. Soft gold-violet light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Thus the last word of peace was spoken — and the age turned toward battle.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing mood like Ep01 wide-gold
Krishna silhouette or calm figure before dawn plains of destiny
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold plains at dawn; Krishna stands calmly facing the horizon of coming war. Quiet epic. Ornate lotus frame. Match Ep01 gold mood. Not photoreal.
